correctness.rationale: The strata are indexed by stable labelled-leaf trees; finite étale descent turns this finite permuted set into the stated index scheme, so extension counts are fixed points of the relevant powers, regardless of field characteristic. The geometric counts follow from binary tree leaf insertion (945) and counting single-edge contractions with three binary resolutions (945*4/3=1260). Independently rooted at leaf 6 and constructed all binary trees by recursive bipartitions on the other six leaves, encoding each by its non-root clades; deleting one clade enumerated all single-edge contractions. Relabelled each partition representative's powers, taking complements of image clades meeting leaf 6, and computed fixed sets directly. Complete cycle multiplicities were recovered by divisor inversion, not by the source program's orbit traversal. All first-five count rows and both complete spectra matched the frozen certificate. The fifteen one-dimensional rows are distinct; the only first-four collision group consists of (7),(5,2),(5,1,1), with fifth counts 0,210,1260. The zero-dimensional spectra give eleven types with precisely the four stated pair collisions. A finite permutation zeta function is determined by, and determines, its complete fixed-power counts, so these computations give the claimed logical implications and the specified consecutive cutoff.
residual_risks: Sharpness is only for the initial consecutive degrees. The counts are of labels of geometric strata, not rational points on the strata or on the entire moduli space.

evidence: The relevant permutation character is fixed labelled-leaf tree counts by cycle type, restricted to an unrooted stable tree with three internal edges (one four-valent vertex), or to trivalent trees for the comparison. value.rationale: The natural boundary index functor retains enough arithmetic information in dimension one to reconstruct a degree-seven finite étale algebra from five counts, while its trivalent boundary counterpart loses information even when all degrees are used. The exact cutoff and exact collision classes are useful for deciding what arithmetic data can be recovered from this boundary alone, rather than simply reproducing its geometric size.
residual_risks: This is a seven-label reconstruction result, not an implication about all numbers of markings, arbitrary twists, or counts of points on an actual boundary curve.
